AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
June 15, 2010
1:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

PUBLIC HEARINGS
1.
Use Permit UP 2009-06 Applicant: Clear Wireless, LLC (Marc Myers, representative)
Location: 137 E. First Street
A request for approval of a Use Permit to allow co-location of three combination wimax panel antennas and three hybrid directional antennas (for a total of none new antenna array with three antenna sectors ) on an existing steel pole sign located within the South Azusa Avenue Corridor (CSA) zone.
Item F-1 PC Staff Report andAttachments 6-16PC
2.
Modification to Use Permit UP 2005-01, V-2005-03, DR-2005-08 Applicant: Clear Wireless, LLC (Paul Gerst, representative)
Location: 213 E. Foothill Boulevard
A request for approval of a Modification to a Use Permit, Variance and Design Review to allow co-location of three combination panel/parabolic antennas on an existing wireless telecommunication facility. The existing telecommunication facility is a stealth mono-pole design, and the proposed co-location will be installed on an existing antenna array. The subject property is located within the Downtown Civic Center (DCC) zone.
F-2 Staff Report 6-16PC
3.
Use Permit UP 2010-06 Applicant: Clear Wireless, LLC (Paul Gerst, representative)
Location: 960 W. 10th Street
A request for approval of Use permit to allow co-location of six panel antennas and three parabolic antennas on two existing 50 foot tall storage tanks located within the West End Light Industrial District (DW) zone.
F-3 Staff Report and Attachments 6-16PC
